EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Release Gate

Release gate using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

release_gate(baseline, candidate, blockers, evidence_complete=False, comparable=False, summary_pinned=False)

Example input

{
  "baseline": {
    "correctness": 4,
    "autonomy": 4,
    "actionability": 4,
    "safety": 4,
    "concision": 4
  },
  "candidate": {
    "correctness": 4.5,
    "autonomy": 4.5,
    "actionability": 4.5,
    "safety": 4.5,
    "concision": 4.5
  },
  "blockers": 1,
  "evidence_complete": true,
  "comparable": true
}

Example output

{
  "released": false,
  "status": "HELD",
  "checks": {
    "zero_blockers": false,
    "correctness": true,
    "safety": true,
    "weighted": true,
    "published_summary_pinned": false,
    "evidence_complete": true,
    "comparable": true
  }
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py release_gate < examples/release-gate.json

Limits

published_summary_pinned is reported and does not release. evidence_complete is a caller assertion: pass true only after 84 generation and judge rows validate. This helper does not call a model.
